name: Doko e Iku no, Ano Hi
source:
I killed a girl. Who was she...?

The protagonist, Kunimi Kyousuke can't remember the memories of his distant past. Even the details are vague, merely appearing as flashes in his heart.

"I am certainly the one who with this hand did that to the lone girl", he keeps thinking, but can't even remember the time or place it happened. But the memories are slowly entering his mind. He remembers the corpse...

How will Kyousuke deal with his supposed sin?
translation:
我杀了一个女孩。她是谁……？

主人公国见恭介记不起遥远过去的往事，就连细节也模糊不清，只会化作片段偶尔闪过心头。

“确实是我亲手对那个孤身一人的女孩做了那件事。”他始终这样想着，却连事情发生的时间和地点都记不起来。然而，那段记忆正慢慢重回脑海。他想起了尸体……

恭介将如何面对自己可能犯下的罪？
